buyerDetails.heading: USA shipping costs
buyerDetails.copy: Standard U.S. shipping is $14.99 below $150 and free at $150 and above after discounts. Tracking is provided after dispatch.

buyerDetails.heading: Processing and delivery times
buyerDetails.copy: Selected semi-stitched options in the ready-to-ship edit have a verified 3–5 business-day processing window. This is not the arrival time: tailoring and carrier transit add time. Confirm your selected option and event date with LuxeMia before ordering.

buyerDetails.heading: Taxes and import duties
buyerDetails.copy: Taxes collected by LuxeMia, if applicable, are calculated at checkout. Do not assume import duties or carrier fees are included unless checkout explicitly confirms this. Contact LuxeMia before ordering if you need the total landed cost confirmed.

buyerDetails.heading: Returns and order issues
buyerDetails.copy: Change-of-mind returns and exchanges are not accepted, except where applicable law provides otherwise. Report genuine damage, defects, incorrect or missing items within 48 hours with clear photos and a continuous unboxing video. Read the full claim requirements before ordering.
